content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But we need the compound identity. Maybe the sample is implicit: we have to query carbon NMR to see aromatic carbon signals. But we don't know the SMILES. The tools carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, etc. They operate on "sample at hand". Likely there is a hidden sample. So we can call carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR data, then count aromatic carbon peaks (around 120-150 ppm). Let's do that.
